correctness.rationale: The full quantified claim is proved by (i) exact product-graph reduction to K_{mn,mn}, (ii) period four of its arc Grover walk, (iii) direct full coefficient blocks at odd residues and the exact reshaped product G⊗G^T at residue two, (iv) rank-two trace/minor calculation of GG^T, and (v) singular-value products and entropy additivity. The Cauchy–Binet minor count gives the exact determinant 4(m-1)(n-1)/(m²n²); the rank-deficient star boundary and balanced K_{2,2} equality are handled separately. Fixed-edge monotonicity and the simultaneous large-part asymptotic follow algebraically. The standalone independent full tensor-arc simulator passed 90 finite spectral/entropy comparisons; those are corroboration, not infinite proof. Limits: exact initial state, coin, graph family, particle-factor entropy only.

value.rationale: The 2026 source asks when its two-particle walk becomes maximally entangled, making the complete Schmidt spectrum a natural, motivated observable. The calculation proves a structural bound of eight Schmidt modes regardless of the growing 2mn-dimensional one-particle space; it gives a full irregular complete-biclique classification and quantifies exactly which balanced aspect ratio maximizes the finite-graph resource at fixed edges, plus large-size entropy collapse. These are interpretable network-correlation effects, not a parameter renaming or isolated table entry. Reproducible formulas can benchmark quantum-walk entanglement calculations and pinpoint the limits of scalable entanglement generation.
